gates.title: Requirements
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Every must requirement has an objective present or future verification method; scope exclusions and production stops are explicit.
checks.observed: Nine must requirements defined; physical P001 testing remains a required future gate before hardware claim.

gates.notes: The release claim level is design-checks-passed, not prototype-tested.

gates.title: Evidence
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Every functional circuit block has at least one archived Tier A/B primary source, a byte hash, adaptations, and completed engineering checks.
checks.observed: Seven block records verified against ten hashed primary/reference records; redistribution terms are explicit.

gates.title: Schematic
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Fresh official KiCad ERC returns zero violations and PCB-to-schematic parity returns zero findings.
checks.observed: ERC 0; DRC schematic parity 0 at the release source revision.

gates.title: Footprints and BOM
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: All 48 board footprints match source pad geometry and the exact-MPN BOM covers all 44 schematic components.
checks.observed: 48/48 pad-geometry pass; 44/44 components covered in 17 exact-MPN line items.

gates.notes: 22 exposed lib_footprint_mismatch messages are generated metadata/text differences; pad geometry was independently hashed and compared.

gates.title: Power and clock
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Power budget, USB capacitance, fuse/descriptor relationship, and crystal load calculation are numerically documented and consistent with exact values.
checks.observed: 70 mA design budget <100 mA descriptor <250 mA PPTC hold; 4.7 µF bulk restores <10 µF nominal/tolerance margin; 18 pF equal loads plus 3 pF estimated stray target 12 pF.

gates.notes: Current and crystal start margin remain prototype measurements, not claimed measurements.

gates.title: Mechanical
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Board outline, holes, key pitch, connector datum, and enclosure scope are documented and agree with native board statistics.
checks.observed: 101×73 mm; four 2.2 mm holes; 19.05 mm key grid; render and native stats reviewed.

gates.notes: No enclosure/plate fit claim; partial component STEP omits switch bodies.

gates.title: Constraints and rules
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Released rules encode general geometry, USB pair, power, and narrowly scoped connector land-pattern behavior; ignored checks are enumerated.
checks.observed: Official DRC passes severity-all; ignored-rule exposure finds only 22 intentional library metadata mismatches and no hidden connectivity/parity issue.

gates.title: Placement
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Critical USB/ESD/series/MCU, clock, decoupling, ISP/reset, switches, and polarity markings are visually reviewable without detected fabrication-layer error.
checks.observed: Top/bottom 3D renders, assembly PDFs, and independent Gerber composites were inspected; reference, polarity, and J1 THT-process markings are legible.

gates.title: Routing, ground, and DRC
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Fresh official KiCad DRC reports zero violations, zero unconnected, and zero parity issues; supplemental routing and ground audits pass.
checks.observed: DRC 0/0/0; 48 footprints, 365 segments, 34 vias, two GND zones; structural and ground audits pass.

gates.notes: Autorouting was used only after deterministic critical paths; all copper is unlocked. USB is not claimed controlled impedance.

gates.title: Firmware contract and build
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Pinned QMK firmware compiles for ATmega32U4 and all declared matrix, USB, reset, and ISP pins match the released netlist.
checks.observed: QMK commit 9caa5f8; AVR-GCC build pass; 35/35 contract checks pass; HEX SHA-256 750c9466…41cda84.

gates.notes: FEED:0010 is prototype-only and must not be commercially distributed.

gates.title: Manufacturing outputs
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: The DFM/RFQ package contains the required Gerber/drill, exact BOM, SMT CPL, notes, test netlist, exchange CAD, assembly views, and valid archives.
checks.observed: Core verification and augmentation pass; Gerber upload has 11 required members; RFQ and IPC-2581 CRC checks pass; SMT CPL has 30 rows and excludes THT J1.

gates.notes: No VIPPO process remains. Confirm JLCPCB or the selected assembler will perform the explicit J1 THT/wave-selective/manual soldering step.

gates.title: Prototype bring-up
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: P001 must pass current-limited power, rails, clock, both USB orientations, enumeration, DFU/ISP, all-key, ghosting, and soak tests with archived measurements.
checks.observed: No PCB has been fabricated or electrically measured.

gates.notes: Unexecuted by design. Required before prototype-tested or production-validated claim.

gates.title: Release integrity
gates.reviewer: Prime Agent design owner (automated gates plus recorded visual review)

checks.criterion: Core/augmentation verifiers pass, released source hashes match canonical source files, and a complete hash list is generated.
checks.observed: Both verification summaries pass and released source board hash equals canonical board hash at the immutable source-set revision.

gates.notes: Repository-wide worktree is intentionally not claimed clean; release identity is the explicit source-set SHA-256 plus per-artifact hashes.
